observations: Alternator with a black plastic housing and a silver aluminum housing.
The alternator is mounted on a bracket with two mounting bolts.
The housing has a ribbed or slotted design on the side.
The output terminal is visible on the side of the housing.
The item is shown from multiple angles in the photos.

claims.evidence: The brand name is not visible in the photos.
No photo shows this clearly enough to read.

risks.risk: The alternator may be a generic or used part rather than a genuine Sharp Tokumbo brand.
risks.proof: A clear photo of the manufacturer's label or metal plate on the housing.

risks.risk: The internal diodes or regulator may be faulty.
risks.proof: A video showing the alternator producing a steady voltage while connected to a battery.

risks.risk: The output terminal may be loose or corroded.
risks.proof: A close-up photo of the output terminal and a video of it being tested.

proof_requests: Close-up of any label, sticker or metal plate showing the brand and model.
Photo of the manufacturer's label on the housing.
Video of the alternator being tested with a multimeter to check output voltage.
Photo of the output terminal to check for corrosion.
response.reason: The item is known from the photos. What they cannot prove is priced at its worst case until the proof asked for below arrives.
